oracle.textMetrics: injected-identical-metrics; geometry oracle uses empty boxes
oracle.browserVersions: record full actual userAgent per capture; same binary required for subsequent comparison
oracle.cssAutoMinimum: explicit minWidth/minHeight default 0; oracle resets them to 0

layout.indefinitePercent: intrinsic pass treats percentage as auto; final pass resolves only definite containing dimension; cycle raises LayoutError
layout.percentEdgesReference: containing inline width for all margin/padding percentages; insets use their axis
layout.aspectRatio: derive only missing axis then clamp; both definite axes override ratio
layout.rounding: double precision logical CSS px; no per-node snapping; scissor floors start and ceils end then clamps to target
layout.invalidInput: throw typed LayoutError before committing; previous valid result remains intact
layout.abort: AbortSignal before/after measure and every bounded traversal chunk; no partial commit

flex.algorithm: form lines with hypothetical sizes first; distribute grow/shrink per line, freeze clamped items and redistribute; scaled shrink weight = shrink * flex base; justify only remaining space after flexing

grid.tracks: explicit px/percent/fr and minmax(px-or-percent,px-or-percent-or-fr); minimum cannot be fr; fixed maximum below minimum becomes minimum
grid.placement: zero-based column/row, positive spans; row-major sparse auto placement skipping occupied cells; no implicit tracks; reject overflow or overlap
grid.gaps: subtract gaps before fr allocation; include intervening gaps in span

hya.mapping: point->px, hug->auto, fraction/fill main-axis->grow weight with zero basis; grid fraction->fr; old missing shrink -> 0
hya.compatibility: one shared solver with explicit hya-v1 compatibility switches at documented phases; old documents retain observed geometry; gui-v1 applies corrected semantics; no second solver or silent format change

region.initialization: always initialize a new target before sampling, regardless of clear/update preference
region.onceConsumption: after successful submitted update; cancelled/lost/hidden requests remain pending
region.pixelStorage: owned persistent targets, never canvas previous texture
region.physicalRect: floor(min*DPR), ceil(max*DPR), intersect target; input inverse uses unsnapped logical rect
region.alpha: premultiplied linear internal compositing; output conversion exactly once
region.loadStore: load valid retained color, store retained outputs; resolve full attachment considered; disable partial-MSAA path until pixel evidence
region.idle: no presentation acquisition/encoding/submission when all regions valid and inactive; independent business clock

cacheLimit.include: all live cached colors, MSAA colors, resolves and retirement overlap; depth counted separately in total GPU resource budget
cacheLimit.overflow: explicit diagnostic and direct redraw fallback; never invisible eviction
cacheLimit.retire: after last in-flight submission, same owner/device generation

region.dirtyRect: optional after whole-region correctness; effects expand dependencies or force full redraw

input.routing: GUI consumes before scene default/unhandled actions; device state sampling remains shared
input.capture: one owner per pointerId until up/cancel; cancel on blur/pause/removal/modal block
input.tabOrder: explicit tabIndex then stable tree order; negative excludes sequential traversal; disabled/hidden excluded
input.directionalOrder: explicit neighbour then forward half-plane by angle, distance and stable ID; visual row reversal does not reorder tree
input.modal: trap scope and restore previous valid focus else first eligible element
input.navigation: InputMap UI actions; active text/slider consumes dedicated keys before navigation

text.interactiveBoundary: extended grapheme cluster UAX29 Unicode 15.1 corpus; platform segmenter allowed only if corpus passes; no font parser dependency
text.normalizeIndex: clamp then snap backward to nearest grapheme boundary; selection nonempty expands start backward/end forward
text.deletion: one extended grapheme cluster; malformed lone surrogate cannot be created by editing valid input
text.ime: preedit separate from committed value; composition commits once; cancellation restores prior selection; focus loss commits current native preedit only if host confirms, otherwise cancels
text.async: generation-token guarded clipboard and host callbacks
text.native: host owns platform text responder/IME, caret screen rectangle and keyboard inset; Engine owns edit model; no UIKit/Android SDK in Engine

theme.metrics: font/size/icon/contentInsets change layout and paint; colors only paint
theme.ownership: borrow caller resources; own generated caches; unsubscribe before replacement/dispose
theme.nineSlice: shared pure computeNineSlicePatches in Engine geometry; HYA uses public geometry export; scale opposite borders proportionally when destination smaller than sum; allow atlas UV subrect; old HYA repeat/mirror maintained

composites.owner: GUI layout extension owns SplitPanel/TabContainer composition; Engine owns primitive GuiNineSlice, theme, focus, text and DnD protocols
composites.split: ratio 0..1; clamp to child minima; insufficient space overflows content and enables parent scroll; no negative sizes
composites.tabs: stable page IDs; active-only hit/layout/paint; preserve pending invalidation and business state; callbacks/transients not serialized

dragDrop.owner: Engine GUI protocol with optional extension composition
dragDrop.payload: unknown caller-owned data, no cloning/OS handles
dragDrop.drop: revalidate target then exactly once; reject/cancel zero commits
dragDrop.keyboard: pick up focused source, navigate eligible target, confirm/cancel via UI actions
dragDrop.preview: global overlay, ignores hit testing, borrowed resource cleanup

sampling.timing: CPU wall, per-phase raw samples; no GPU timing from audit device

workloads.tree: one root, flat fixed 40x24 children, wrap, gap 4; fixed synthetic fixture text

acceptance.framePacingReference: config/framegraph-production-021.json; same hard P95/P99/long-frame budgets, per target device refresh class
acceptance.gpuAndOtherBudgets: existing release budgets and named investigations unchanged
acceptance.newCpuLimits: fixed before G02; target-host microphase targets supported by G01 direct-GUI diagnostic; full native production qualification remains required
acceptance.releaseWiring: G10 validates real artifacts and wires contract; G01 runner is diagnostic and cannot grant release qualification
acceptance.cpuLimitRationale: 60Hz frame is 16.67ms: HUD layout and measure each 1/8 frame (2ms), GUI 1/4 frame (4ms); pressure phases each half frame (8ms), named G01 host only; 10k diagnostic no fps promise. Legacy full HYA evaluation includes animation/text and is not pure-layout timing.

versions.consumers: Games LED Sudoku and Native examples exact lock to qualified 0.2.2 tarball/registry; unrelated consumers remain unchanged; no cross-repo source imports

@haiyue/animation-spec.condition: G10 admission adds public HYA schema/parser/codec entry; exact symbols and package scope frozen before implementation

deviceMatrix.engineRelease: one existing native qualification path (Windows Chrome+Edge discrete or macOS Chrome Metal); legacy Intel remains extended

additionalRequired.evidence: real Windows or macOS IME composition and keyboard navigation
physical iPhone Native host, Chinese/Latin/emoji preedit/commit/cancel, selection, rotate, keyboard inset, suspend/resume
physical controller complete production UI workflow

deviceMatrix.unavailable: explicit pending; no desktop screenshot or synthetic input substitution

apiAllocationRule: Named proposed symbols only; no extra reserve for new slices. Existing classes gain compatible optional methods only. G10 updates active budgets atomically after actual builds, capability consumers, docs and examples pass. No automatic api:update authorization.

hyaProductionScope.capabilityAdmission: G10 freezes exact focused exports, per-symbol budget and versioned composition contract before G11; no automatic export of all private modules
hyaProductionScope.production: real glyph/image/N-slice, data/state/layout/input/semantics/audio composition, selected vector-paint and text-animator channels
hyaProductionScope.performance: incremental evaluation and capacity-based buffer reuse, real licensed corpus and lifecycle evidence
